exposure: unknown maternal group B Streptococcus status
cohort: 66 newborns born at >=34 weeks' gestation to mothers with prolonged rupture of membranes and unknown group B Streptococcus status
finding: Implementing a protocol using clinical status, biochemical markers, and a neonatal early-onset sepsis calculator significantly decreased the rate of antibiotic administration in newborns of mothers with prolonged rupture of membranes and unknown group B Streptococcus status.
